# meta-lisp

> meta-lisp is a statically typed Lisp dialect with syntax inspired by Scheme and a Hindley-Milner type system similar to Haskell and ML.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/01-getting-started.md): Installation, CLI, first project

## Language Reference

- [Syntax](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/02-syntax.md): Expression forms (if, let, match, pipe, etc.) and top-level statements (module, import, define, claim, etc.)
- [Type System](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/03-type-system.md): Primitive types, compound types, polymorphism, type annotations
- [Data Types](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/04-data-types.md): define-struct, define-enum, define-algebraic-type, pattern matching with match
- [Module System](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/05-module-system.md): modules, imports, qualified names, private declarations
- [Control Flow](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/06-control-flow.md): let, begin, if, cond, pipe/chain/compose, tail recursion
- [Built-in Functions](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/07-builtins.md): Complete reference of all primitive and derived functions organized by type

## Testing

- [Testing](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/08-testing.md): define-test, assertions, running tests

## Examples

- [Cookbook](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/09-cookbook.md): Common patterns: tail recursion, function composition, ADTs, project structure

## FAQ

- [FAQ](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/meta-lisp/10-faq.md): Common questions and differences from TypeScript, Scheme, Haskell

## Optional

- [Define Algebraic Types Tutorial](https://github.com/xieyuheng/x-lisp/blob/main/docs/tutorials/define-algebraic-type.md): In-depth tutorial on algebraic data types
